branches.cn: 逐渐变化是时间中的慢动作。

intro.en: Slowly belongs to the slow family of words.
intro.cn: slowly 属于以 slow 为核心的一组词。

latinIntro.en: The root slow is native English, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 slow 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: The slowness of the service annoyed him.
There was a slowdown in sales.
He is not slow-witted, just quiet.

definition_zh: 云；云朵；阴云；一大群；（网络）云端
definition_en: a white or grey mass of water drops floating in the sky
core_image: 天上飘着的一大团棉花，说变脸就变脸
scene: 操场上体育课，大家抬头看天上的大白云。 Look at that big white cloud over the playground.
sceneCN: 这里 cloud 是「云朵」（第 1 个义项：天上飘浮的水汽团）；句意是看操场上空那朵大白云。

derivatives.zh: 由 cloud  + suffix  -y 构成，义为「多云的；阴天的」
由 cloud  + suffix  -less 构成，义为「无云的；晴朗的」
由 cloudy  + suffix  -ness 构成，义为「多云状态」

senses.title: A floating mass of water drops in the sky
senses.definition: a white or grey mass of tiny water drops in the sky
senses.definitionCN: 天空中由小水滴组成的白色或灰色团块
senses.example: A small cloud crossed the sun during the picnic.
senses.exampleCN: 野餐时一小朵云掠过太阳。
senses.why: Steam from the earth cools high above and gathers into something soft, heavy and visible.
senses.whyCN: 水汽升上高空冷却，聚成柔软、厚重、可见的一团。

senses.title: A mass of smoke, dust or flying things
senses.definition: a moving mass of smoke, dust or small flying insects
senses.definitionCN: 烟雾、尘土或飞虫形成的移动团块
senses.example: The car left a cloud of dust on the road.
senses.exampleCN: 汽车在路上扬起一团尘土。
senses.why: Anything that floats and hides the view behaves like sky-clouds, so the name flies down to earth.
senses.whyCN: 凡是飘浮遮挡视线的东西都像天上的云，这个名字便落到地上。

senses.title: Something that hides truth or spoils happiness
senses.definition: something that darkens a situation or a person's good name
senses.definitionCN: 使形势黯淡或名誉受损的事物
senses.example: The argument cast a cloud over the party.
senses.exampleCN: 争吵给聚会蒙上了阴影。
senses.why: Real clouds darken the sky; worries darken the mind, so the picture is borrowed for feelings.
senses.whyCN: 真的云遮蔽天空，忧愁遮蔽心情，画面便被借来形容情绪。

senses.title: To make something less clear
senses.definition: to make an idea, glass or memory less clear
senses.definitionCN: 让想法、玻璃或记忆变得模糊
senses.example: Tears clouded her eyes as she said goodbye.
senses.exampleCN: 道别时泪水模糊了她的双眼。
senses.why: A mist in front of the eyes works like a cloud in front of the sun.
senses.whyCN: 眼前的雾气就像太阳前的云。

intro.en: Cloud once meant something more solid than the sky: it began as a rock.
intro.cn: cloud 最初指比天空更坚实的东西：它起源于岩石。

items.en: Old English clud meant a mass of rock or a hill.
items.cn: 古英语 clud 指岩石堆或山丘。

items.en: People compared a big grey sky-mass to a pile of rocks, and the name transferred.
items.cn: 人们把灰白的大团云比作一堆岩石，名字随之转移。

items.en: By Middle English the sky sense had won completely and the rock sense was gone.
items.cn: 到中古英语，天空义完全获胜，岩石义消失。

items.en: Modern English kept cloud for sky masses, smoke and gloomy feelings.
items.cn: 现代英语用 cloud 指云、烟团和阴郁情绪。

items.en: In the internet age cloud was borrowed again for faraway computer storage.
items.cn: 互联网时代，cloud 又被借指远程计算机存储，即云端。

note.en: The first group collects the cloud family; the second collects sky words.
note.cn: 第一组收 cloud 词族，第二组收天空相关词。

entries.definition: Covered with many clouds.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「多云的」，由 cloud 加 -y 构成。

entries.definition: Having no clouds at all.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「万里无云的」，由 cloud 加 -less 构成。

entries.definition: Influence or a heavy blow.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「影响力；重击」，拼写与 cloud 相近但词源不同。

entries.definition: Cloud that touches the ground.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「雾」，是贴近地面的云。

entries.definition: Thin fog in the morning.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「薄雾」，比 fog 更轻。

entries.definition: Dusty air that blurs the distance.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「霾；雾霭」，使远处模糊。

normalIntro.en: Remember cloud through its rocky past and its modern home above computers.
normalIntro.cn: 从「岩石」的过去与电脑上方的现在记忆 cloud。

normal.en: cloud first meant a rock or hill.
normal.cn: cloud 最初指岩石或山丘。

normal.en: cloudy is cloud plus -y.
normal.cn: cloudy 是 cloud 加 -y。

normal.en: a cloud of dust rises behind cars.
normal.cn: 车后扬起 a cloud of dust。

normal.en: photos saved in the cloud live far away.
normal.cn: 存在云端的照片在很远的地方。

normal.en: under a cloud means being doubted.
normal.cn: under a cloud 指受到怀疑。

abstract.en: Lie on the grass and name the shapes in the drifting white.
abstract.cn: 躺在草地上给漂过的白云起名字。

abstract.en: Feel the cool grey blanket pressing before the rain.
abstract.cn: 感受雨前灰云压顶的清凉。

abstract.en: Watch a sad thought settle like fog over a sunny day.
abstract.cn: 看忧愁像雾一样罩住晴天。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered, and we ran back to school.
examples.cn: 乌云聚拢，我们跑回了学校。

examples.en: The photos are saved in the cloud, not on this phone.
examples.cn: 照片存在云端，不在这部手机上。

examples.en: Smoke clouded the small kitchen while lunch burned.
examples.cn: 午饭烧糊时，烟雾弥漫了小厨房。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克劳德」——克劳德躺在草地上看云，cloud 就是他头顶那朵大白云。

root: 古英语 clud（岩石堆）→ 词义转移到灰白的天空大团 → 中古英语 cloud（云）→ 现代英语 cloud（云、烟团、阴影、云端）；派生词有 cloudy（多云的）、cloudless（无云的）。

sensesIntro.en: Cloud drifts from sky masses to smoke, shadows and even computer storage.
sensesIntro.cn: cloud 从天上的云团延伸到烟尘、阴影，甚至网络存储。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a soft grey-white mass that floats and hides
core.cn: 核心意象：一团漂浮且遮蔽视线的灰白色软团

branches.en: Water drops in the sky
branches.cn: 天上的水汽团

branches.en: Smoke and dust masses
branches.cn: 烟尘之团

branches.en: Gloom and doubt
branches.cn: 阴郁与疑虑

branches.en: Blurred sight and memory
branches.cn: 模糊的视线与记忆

branches.en: The modern digital sky
branches.cn: 现代的数字天空

intro.en: Cloud builds weather words with simple English endings.
intro.cn: cloud 用简单的英语词缀构建天气词族。

latinIntro.en: Cloud is Germanic, so Latin lives only in borrowed science words like nimbus.
latinIntro.cn: cloud 属日耳曼词源，拉丁语只出现在借入的科学词如 nimbus 中。

items.example: It was cloudy on sports day.
A cloudless sky promised a good trip.
items.exampleCN: 万里无云预示旅途顺利。

items.example: The cloudiness lasted a whole week.
items.exampleCN: 多云天气持续了一整周。

items.example: Fog covered the fields at dawn.
A mist rose from the river.
A summer haze hid the hills.
The sky was overcast all day.

definition_zh: 粗心地；漫不经心地；随手地
definition_en: in a way that shows no care or attention, so that mistakes or damage follow
core_image: 随手把外套一抛，袖子挂在了椅背上
scene: 值日时，他随手把扫帚往角落一扔就跑了。 After cleaning, he dropped the broom into the corner carelessly and ran off.
sceneCN: 这里 carelessly 是「随手地；漫不经心地」（第 1 个义项：不留神、不加注意地做事）；句意为值日后随手扔下扫帚就走。

pos.zh: 粗心地；漫不经心地；随手地

derivatives.zh: 其形容词原级，义为「粗心的」
由 careless 加 -ness 构成，义为「粗心大意」

senses.title: Without attention, causing mistakes
senses.definition: doing something without the attention it needs
senses.definitionCN: 做事缺少应有的注意
senses.example: He wrote the date carelessly and got it wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 他随手写日期，结果写错了。
senses.why: The -less heart minus its watchfulness becomes the very manner of the action.
senses.whyCN: 把「小心」抽走，剩下的样子正是行动的方式。

senses.title: In a relaxed, unconcerned manner
senses.definition: in a way that shows no worry or effort
senses.definitionCN: 显得毫不费力、毫不在意
senses.example: She tossed her hair back carelessly and laughed.
senses.exampleCN: 她随手把头发一甩，笑了。
senses.why: Indifference too has a posture, and the adverb names that slouch.
senses.whyCN: 冷淡也有姿态，这个副词就叫出那副懒散样。

intro.en: Carelessly hangs one more ending on the care family tree.
intro.cn: carelessly 不过在 care 词族上再挂一枚后缀。

items.en: Old English caru supplies the heavy mind again.
items.cn: 古英语 caru 再一次供给沉重的心。

items.en: Middle English carlees first meant worry-free.
items.cn: 中古英语 carlees 起初指无忧无虑。

items.en: -less removed the care and left the habit of slips.
items.cn: -less 拿走了「心」，只留下毛手毛脚的习惯。

items.en: The adverb -ly fixed the manner into grammar.
items.cn: 副词后缀 -ly 把这种方式固定进语法。

items.en: Modern carelessly blames sloppy hands and lazy poses alike.
items.cn: 今天 carelessly 既指毛手毛脚，也指懒散姿态。

note.en: The first group collects family adverbs; the second collects sloppy-manner adverbs.
note.cn: 第一组收词族副词，第二组收马虎类副词。

entries.definition: In a careful way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「小心地」，是反义词。

entries.definition: Too many to count.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「数不清的」，拼写与 carelessly 词首相近。

entries.definition: Without aim or plan.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「漫无目的地」，同为 -lessly 结尾。

entries.definition: In a negligent way, formal use.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「疏忽地」，正式用语。

entries.definition: Not carefully or exactly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「粗略地；粗糙地」。

entries.definition: Wildly without care of danger.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「鲁莽地」，程度更重。

normalIntro.en: Remember carelessly as careless plus ly.
normalIntro.cn: carelessly 就是 careless 加 ly。

normal.en: careless + ly = carelessly, one small step.
normal.cn: careless 加 ly，一步成副词。

normal.en: a carelessly made bed sags in the middle.
normal.cn: 马虎铺的床中间塌陷。

normal.en: its opposite is carefully.
normal.cn: 它的反义词是 carefully。

normal.en: carelessly dressed looks untidy.
normal.cn: carelessly dressed 即穿得邋遢。

normal.en: aimlessly shares the same -lessly tail.
normal.cn: aimlessly 有同样的 -lessly 尾巴。

abstract.en: Hear a glass ring sloppily set down on the desk.
abstract.cn: 听杯子随手搁上桌面的声响。

abstract.en: See chalk dust left all over the tray.
abstract.cn: 想象粉笔灰撒满讲台。

abstract.en: Watch a shoelace dragging, tied in a hurry.
abstract.cn: 鞋带匆匆一系，垂地拖行。

examples.en: The parcel was carelessly wrapped and came open.
examples.cn: 包裹包得马虎，路上散开了。

examples.en: She carelessly left her keys on the bus.
examples.cn: 她随手把钥匙落在了公交车上。

examples.en: Don't drive carelessly on icy roads.
examples.cn: 结冰路上开车不可大意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「凯尔勒斯利」——凯尔「累死」了还硬撑，动作自然马虎。

root: care（挂念）+ -less（无）+ -ly（方式）→ carelessly；同族 careless、carelessness、carefully。

sensesIntro.en: Carelessly names the manner of hands and hearts that stopped watching.
sensesIntro.cn: carelessly 命名「不再看路」的手与心的姿态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a throw instead of a place
core.cn: 核心意象：随手一抛，而非轻轻一放

branches.en: Work done sloppily
branches.cn: 做得马虎的活儿

branches.en: Lazy unconcerned poses
branches.cn: 懒散随意的姿态

branches.en: Losing and breaking things
branches.cn: 丢东西与弄坏东西

branches.en: Offhand speech
branches.cn: 随口说出的话

branches.en: The look of forgotten care
branches.cn: 忘了「心」时的样子

intro.en: Carelessly stacks three Germanic endings on one root.
intro.cn: carelessly 在一个词根上叠了三个日耳曼后缀。

latinIntro.en: No Latin element appears; the endings carry everything.
latinIntro.cn: 全词不见拉丁成分，全靠后缀撑起。

items.example: He came to class carelessly dressed.

definition_en: a person admired for courage or great achievements, or the main male character in a story
core_image: 众人仰望的那个人：危难时刻站了出来
scene: 洪水冲垮堤岸时，一个少年连续救起三个孩子，全镇都称他为英雄。 The town called the boy a hero after he pulled three children from the flood.
sceneCN: 这里 hero 是「英雄」（第 1 个义项：因勇气受敬仰的人）；少年救人的勇气赢得全镇敬仰。

derivatives.zh: 由 hero 加 -ic 构成，义为「英勇的；英雄的」
由 heroic 加 -ly 构成，义为「英勇地」
hero 的阴性形式，义为「女英雄；女主角」
由 hero 加 -ism 构成，义为「英雄气概」

senses.title: A person admired for great courage
senses.definition: a person admired for brave or noble deeds, especially in danger
senses.definitionCN: 因勇敢或高尚的行为而受敬仰的人，尤指临危之时
senses.example: Firefighters are often called heroes.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员常被称为英雄。
senses.why: Great courage sets a person apart, and the crowd names that person a hero.
senses.whyCN: 非凡的勇气使人出类拔萃，众人便称其为英雄。

senses.title: The main male character in a story
senses.definition: the main male character in a novel, film, or story
senses.definitionCN: 小说、电影或故事中的男主角
senses.example: The hero finally defeats the villain in the last chapter.
senses.exampleCN: 男主角在最后一章终于击败了反派。
senses.why: Stories centre on one strong figure; the old word for that figure is hero.
senses.whyCN: 故事围绕一个强力人物展开，这个人物的老称呼就是 hero。

senses.title: Someone greatly admired in a field
senses.definition: a person admired for a special skill or achievement
senses.definitionCN: 因特殊才能或成就而受崇拜的人
senses.example: Young players treat the former champion as their hero.
senses.exampleCN: 年轻球员把那位前冠军当作偶像。
senses.why: Skill at a level others dream of earns the same awe as courage.
senses.whyCN: 达到他人梦想级别的技艺，会赢得与勇气同等的崇拜。

intro.en: Hero travelled from Greek myth into Latin, French, and finally English.
intro.cn: hero 从希腊神话出发，经拉丁语、法语传入英语。

items.en: Greek hērōs meant a protector or defender, later a demigod honoured after death.
items.cn: 希腊语 hērōs 意为保护者、守护者，后指死后受尊崇的半神。

items.en: Latin borrowed heros for legendary men of great courage.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 heros，指传奇中的勇者。

items.en: Old French heros carried the word into medieval Europe.
items.cn: 古法语 heros 把这个词带入中世纪欧洲。

items.en: Middle English hero(e) first meant men of superhuman strength in romances.
items.cn: 中古英语 hero(e) 最初指骑士文学里具有超人力量的人物。

items.en: Modern English widened hero to war heroes, story leads, and idols.
items.cn: 现代英语把 hero 扩展到战争英雄、故事主角和偶像。

note.en: These words share roots or meanings with hero.
note.cn: 以下词与 hero 同根或义近。

entries.definition: adjective meaning very brave or grand
entries.definitionCN: 派生形容词，义为「英勇的；壮烈的」

entries.definition: female hero or lead character
entries.definitionCN: 阴性名词，义为「女英雄；女主角」

entries.definition: the quality of being a hero
entries.definitionCN: 派生名词，义为「英雄气概」

entries.definition: a person who fights or wins for others
entries.definitionCN: 为他人而战或取胜的人，义近「斗士；冠军」

entries.definition: a person adored by fans
entries.definitionCN: 受粉丝崇拜的人，义为「偶像」

entries.definition: a very famous and admired person
entries.definitionCN: 广受赞誉的名人，义为「传奇人物」

normalIntro.en: Use the Greek root and the word family.
normalIntro.cn: 用希腊词根和词族记忆 hero。

normal.en: Greek hērōs = protector: a hero protects others.
normal.cn: 希腊语 hērōs 意为「保护者」：英雄就是保护他人的人。

normal.en: hero + -ic = heroic; hero + -ism = heroism.
normal.cn: hero 加 -ic 成 heroic（英勇的），加 -ism 成 heroism（英雄气概）。

normal.en: The plural needs -es: one hero, two heroes.
normal.cn: 复数要加 -es：一个 hero，两个 heroes。

normal.en: heroine is the female hero, with -ine like in Josephine.
normal.cn: heroine 是女英雄，-ine 如人名 Josephine 中的阴性后缀。

normal.en: A hero sandwich is hero in name only.
normal.cn: hero sandwich（大号三明治）只是借用 hero 之名，与英雄无关。

abstract.en: Picture a figure standing on a wall between the storm and the crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站在墙上，挡在风暴与人群之间——hero 的剪影。

abstract.en: Hear the crowd roar one name: that name is the hero.
abstract.cn: 听见人群齐吼一个名字——那就是 hero 的声音。

abstract.en: Feel hero as a spotlight aimed at one brave silhouette.
abstract.cn: 把 hero 感受成打在一个勇敢剪影上的追光。

examples.en: The doctor worked heroically through the night to save the injured.
examples.cn: 医生英勇地通宵救治伤员。

examples.en: My grandmother is my hero; she raised five children alone.
examples.cn: 祖母是我的英雄，她独自抚养了五个孩子。

examples.en: In the film, the hero must choose between love and duty.
examples.cn: 在电影里，男主角必须在爱与责任之间做出选择。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「黑柚」——「黑夜里抱着大柚子救人的人」，像 hero（英雄）。

root: hero 源自希腊语 hērōs（保护者；半神），经拉丁语 heros、古法语 heros 进入中古英语。词根的更早来源不确定，一般认为与「守护、护卫」观念相关。

sensesIntro.en: From battlefield courage to story leads to admired idols, hero centres on the person others look up to.
sensesIntro.cn: hero 的义项从战场勇气扩展到故事主角与崇拜偶像，核心始终是「被人仰望的人」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one figure standing above the crowd in a hard moment
core.cn: 核心意象：艰难时刻站在人群之上的那个人

branches.en: bravery admired by all
branches.cn: 众人敬仰的勇敢（义项 01）

branches.en: the centre of a story
branches.cn: 故事的中心人物（义项 02）

branches.en: awe earned by talent
branches.cn: 以才能赢得的崇拜（义项 03）

branches.en: a person people look up to
branches.cn: 被人仰望的人（义项 01 · 03）

branches.en: the male lead in fiction
branches.cn: 虚构作品的男主角（义项 02）

intro.en: Hero forms a rich family with Greek-based suffixes.
intro.cn: hero 带动一个以希腊语源后缀构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin heros kept the same stem; Romance languages show heroe forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 heros 保留同一词干，罗曼语族有 heroe 形式。

items.example: They made a heroic effort to save the ship.
The crew fought heroically against the storm.
items.exampleCN: 船员们英勇地与风暴搏斗。

items.meaning: brave behaviour; the spirit of a hero
items.example: His heroism was reported in the news.
items.exampleCN: 他的英勇事迹上了新闻。

items.meaning: a female hero or main character
items.example: The heroine of the novel is a doctor.
items.exampleCN: 小说的女主角是一位医生。

items.meaningCN: 盲目崇拜；把某人当偶像
items.exampleCN: 他的粉丝表现出真正的偶像崇拜。
这座城市向英雄们致敬。

items.meaning: a main character without noble qualities
items.example: The novel's antihero lies and cheats.
items.exampleCN: 小说的反英雄撒谎作弊。

items.meaningCN: 拉丁语源近义词：英勇的
items.example: The valiant knight held the gate.

definition_zh: 保护；防护；保护措施；保护区
definition_en: the state or act of being kept safe from harm, or a measure that keeps something safe
core_image: 一把撑开的伞把雨挡在头顶之外，伞骨下是一小片干的区域
scene: 举报人担心遭到报复，于是向监察机构求助。 The new law offers protection for whistle-blowers who report waste.
sceneCN: 这里 protection 指「法律提供的保护措施」（第 2 个义项：由制度或规则提供的安全保障，使某人免受伤害或报复）；句意为新法律为举报浪费行为的吹哨人提供保护。图中可辨识物件：法律文本、举报信封、监察机构门牌、撑开的伞；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 保护；防护；保护措施；保护区（可数或不可数）

derivatives.zh: 保护；防护
保护的；防护的
保护者；防护装置
保护主义
保护主义者；保护主义的

senses.title: Physical shielding from harm
senses.definition: the state of being covered or guarded so that harm cannot reach
senses.definitionCN: 被覆盖或看守、使伤害无法到达的状态
senses.example: The umbrella offered little protection against the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 那把伞对风几乎起不到防护作用。
senses.why: The Latin noun named a covering; the modern sense keeps that image of something placed between a person and a threat.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词命名一层遮盖；现代义保留「把某物置于人与威胁之间」的意象。

senses.title: Legal or institutional safeguard
senses.definition: a rule, law or arrangement that keeps a person or group safe from harm or retaliation
senses.definitionCN: 使个人或群体免受伤害或报复的规则、法律或安排
senses.example: The new law offers protection for whistle-blowers who report waste.
senses.exampleCN: 新法律为举报浪费行为的吹哨人提供保护。
senses.why: The law takes the place of the umbrella and stands between a person and a threat.
senses.whyCN: 法律替代雨伞，立在人与其威胁之间。

senses.title: Environmental conservation
senses.definition: measures taken to keep ecosystems, species or resources from damage
senses.definitionCN: 为防止生态系统、物种或资源受损而采取的措施
senses.example: The reserve was created for the protection of nesting turtles.
senses.exampleCN: 这个保护区是为保护筑巢海龟而设立的。
senses.why: Nature cannot hold an umbrella, so a reserve is built around it.
senses.whyCN: 自然无法自己撑伞，于是围绕它建立保护区。

senses.title: Social security against hardship
senses.definition: public arrangements that shield people from poverty, illness or unemployment
senses.definitionCN: 使人们免受贫困、疾病或失业的公共安排
senses.example: Social protection kept the family afloat after the layoff.
senses.exampleCN: 失业后，社会保障让这个家庭撑了下来。
senses.why: Hardship is a threat, so public arrangements are built as a cover.
senses.whyCN: 困境是一种威胁，于是公共安排被搭成遮盖。

senses.title: Safeguarding of personal data
senses.definition: rules and technical measures that keep personal information from misuse
senses.definitionCN: 防止个人信息被滥用的规则与技术措施
senses.example: Data protection requires consent before sharing.
senses.exampleCN: 数据保护要求在共享前取得同意。
senses.why: Information can be harmed, so rules form a layer around it.
senses.whyCN: 信息会受损，于是规则在它周围形成一层。

senses.title: Trade protection for domestic producers
senses.titleCN: 对本国生产者的贸易保护
senses.definition: tariffs or quotas that shield local industries from foreign competition
senses.definitionCN: 使本地产业免受外国竞争的关税或配额
senses.example: The minister argued for temporary protection of the steel sector.
senses.exampleCN: 部长主张对钢铁行业实行临时保护。
senses.why: A market under foreign competition is shielded like a town under attack.
senses.whyCN: 面对外国竞争的市场像受攻击的城镇一样被遮蔽。

senses.title: A protected area
senses.definition: a place legally set aside where wildlife or a site is shielded from development
senses.definitionCN: 依法划出、使野生动物或遗址免受开发的地方
senses.example: The reef is a marine protection where anchoring is banned.
senses.exampleCN: 这片珊瑚礁是一处禁止下锚的海洋保护区。
senses.why: When protection is fixed to a place, the abstract noun becomes a mapped area.
senses.whyCN: 当保护固定在某个地点，抽象名词就变成地图上的区域。

senses.title: Gear worn against injury
senses.definition: equipment worn to absorb impact or prevent injury in sport or work
senses.definitionCN: 在运动或工作中吸收冲击、防止受伤的装备
senses.example: Knee protection is compulsory on the course.
senses.exampleCN: 这条赛道上必须佩戴护膝。
senses.why: Padding is the umbrella worn on the body.
senses.whyCN: 护具是穿在身上的伞。

intro.en: Protection comes from Latin protectio 'a covering, defence', from protegere 'to cover in front', through French protection. The word is recorded in English from the fourteenth century.
intro.cn: protection 经法语 protection 来自拉丁 protectio「遮盖、防御」，后者出自 protegere「在前面遮盖」。英语自 14 世纪有记录。

items.en: Tegere 'to cover' gives the family its core image of a roof or shield over something.
items.cn: tegere「覆盖」给该词族提供核心意象：某物上方的屋顶或盾牌。

items.en: Protegere 'to cover in front, shield' added pro- 'before' to tegere.
items.cn: protegere「在前面遮盖、屏蔽」在 tegere 前加上 pro-「在前」。

items.en: Protectio named the covering or the act of shielding; its stem supplies protection and protector.
items.cn: protectio 命名遮盖或屏蔽行为；其词干提供 protection 与 protector。

items.en: Old French protection passed into English in the 1300s, first in legal and military contexts.
items.cn: 古法语 protection 于 14 世纪进入英语，最初用于法律与军事语境。

items.en: Environmental, data and social protection are nineteenth- and twentieth-century extensions of the legal sense.
items.cn: 环境、数据与社会保护是 19、20 世纪从法律义延伸出来的用法。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest English use is not precisely dated and the fourteenth-century figure is approximate. The Latin protegere and protectio layers are secure.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：最早的英语使用没有精确年代，14 世纪之数为约数；拉丁 protegere 与 protectio 这两层可靠。

note.en: Group one separates the noun from the verb, adjective and agent of the family; group two separates forms of safeguarding by scope.
note.cn: 第一组区分该名词与同族动词、形容词、施动者；第二组按范围区分各类保障。

entries.definition: The adjective describing a guarding quality; protection is the thing provided.
entries.definitionCN: 描述防护性质的形容词；protection 是被提供的东西。

entries.definition: One who or that which protects; protection is the state or measure, not the agent.
entries.definitionCN: 指保护者或防护装置；protection 是状态或措施，不是施动者。

entries.definition: The action of shielding; protection is the resulting state or the arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 指屏蔽动作；protection 是结果状态或安排。

entries.definition: Specific safeguards, as in legal protections; the singular is usually the general state.
entries.definitionCN: 指具体保障措施，如法律保护条款；单数多为一般状态。

entries.definition: Resistance to a specific attack; protection is broader and includes prevention and care.
entries.definitionCN: 指对具体攻击的抵抗；protection 更宽，包含预防与照料。

entries.definition: The condition of being safe; protection is the measure that produces it.
entries.definitionCN: 指安全的状态；protection 是产生该状态的措施。

entries.definition: Careful management to prevent loss of natural or cultural resources; it is one form of protection.
entries.definitionCN: 指防止自然或文化资源流失的谨慎管理；是保护的一种形式。

entries.definition: Keeping a person in official care; protection can be legal without detention.
entries.definitionCN: 指由官方照管某人；protection 可以是法律性的而不涉及拘留。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin noun of covering, the real family, and the collocations of law, environment and data.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁「遮盖」名词、真实词族，以及法律、环境与数据领域的固定搭配。

normal.en: protegere 'cover in front' + -ion: the state of being covered.
normal.cn: protegere「在前面遮盖」+ -ion：被遮盖的状态。

normal.en: The family runs protect, protection, protective, protector, protectionism.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 protect、protection、protective、protector、protectionism。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: environmental protection, data protection, legal protection.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 environmental protection、data protection、legal protection。

normal.en: The noun is countable when it means specific measures.
normal.cn: 指具体措施时，这个名词可数。

normal.en: One umbrella covers rain, law, reefs and knees.
normal.cn: 一把伞同时覆盖雨、法律、珊瑚礁与膝盖。

abstract.en: Picture an umbrella holding a dry circle open in a downpour.
abstract.cn: 想象一把伞在暴雨中撑开一小片干燥的圆。

abstract.en: Picture a statute standing between a witness and a threat.
abstract.cn: 想象一条法规立在证人与威胁之间。

abstract.en: Picture a reef marked off by buoys so that no anchor can fall.
abstract.cn: 想象一片珊瑚礁被浮标圈起，任何锚都落不下去。

examples.en: The helmet gives reliable protection against a fall.
examples.cn: 头盔能在摔倒时提供可靠的保护。

examples.en: The park was declared a protection for the last wild herd.
examples.cn: 这座公园被宣布为最后一群野生兽群的保护区。

examples.en: Consumer protection laws require clear labelling.
examples.cn: 消费者保护法要求标示清楚。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「protect（保护）+ -ion（状态）」——被护住的状态 → 保护；防护

root: 拉丁 pro-「在前」+ tegere「覆盖」→ protegere「在前面遮盖」→ protectio「遮盖、防御」→ 法语 protection → 英语 protection。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one umbrella: rain over a head, law over a witness, rules over a reef, welfare over a family, consent over data, a tariff over a mill, a reserve over turtles, and padding over a knee.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享同一把伞：替头顶挡雨、替证人挡法外报复、替珊瑚礁挡开发、替家庭挡困境、替数据挡滥用、替工厂挡竞争、替海龟挡侵扰、替膝盖挡冲击。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open umbrella holding a small dry circle inside a downpour.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把撑开的伞在暴雨中守住一小片干燥的圆。

branches.en: PHYSICAL COVER: umbrellas, helmets and padding take the blow.
branches.cn: 物理遮盖：伞、头盔与护具承受冲击。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONAL COVER: law, welfare and consent rules stand in for the umbrella.
branches.cn: 制度遮盖：法律、福利与同意规则替代雨伞。

branches.en: CONSERVATION: measures that keep ecosystems from damage.
branches.cn: 保护措施：防止生态系统受损的行动。

branches.en: TRADE COVER: tariffs shield producers from competition.
branches.cn: 贸易遮盖：关税使生产者免受竞争。

branches.en: PLACE: protection becomes a bounded area on a map.
branches.cn: 地点：保护变成地图上一块有边界的地方。

intro.en: Protection is a Latin action noun in -io built on the protegere stem; English adds further suffixes for agent, quality and doctrine.
intro.cn: protection 是由 protegere 词干加 -io 构成的拉丁动作名词；英语再加后缀表示施动者、性质与主义。

latinIntro.en: Latin protegere, protectio and tectus carry the covering image into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 protegere、protectio 与 tectus 把「遮盖」意象带入英语。

items.example: Protection from the sun matters at noon.
The treaty made the state a protector.
items.exampleCN: 条约使该国成为保护者。

items.meaning: a policy of shielding domestic industry
items.exampleCN: 保护主义抬高国内价格。

items.meaning: one who favours such a policy
items.exampleCN: 那名保护主义者阻挠了条约。

items.example: Environmental protection is written into the charter.

items.exampleCN: 数据保护规则限制共享。

items.meaning: a legal order to keep someone safe
items.meaningCN: 保护某人安全的法院命令
items.example: A protection order was served that night.
items.exampleCN: 当晚送达了一份保护令。

definition_zh: 数；数字；号码；数量；编号；总计
definition_en: a word or symbol used for counting, a label that identifies something, an amount or total, and the act of counting a group
core_image: 一列整齐的算珠，每一颗都占着一个可以数出来的位置
scene: 深夜的急诊室门口，护士低头核对登记本，把票上的号码念了出来。 The clerk read the number on the ticket and called the next patient in.
sceneCN: 这里的 number 是「号码」（第 2 个义项：用来识别身份的编号）；句意为工作人员读出票上的号码，叫下一位病人进来。图中可辨识物件：登记本、排号票、叫号屏。

derivatives.zh: 由 number 加表示「没有」的后缀 -less 构成，义为「数不清的；无数的」
由 number 加 -ing 构成，义为「编号；编号方式」
与拉丁词根 numerus（数）同源，加 -ous 后义为「众多的」

senses.title: A word or symbol used for counting
senses.definition: a word or written sign, such as three or seven, used to count things or to show an amount
senses.definitionCN: 用来计数或表示数量的词或书写符号，例如「三」或「七」
senses.example: Write the number seven at the top of the page.
senses.exampleCN: 把数字七写在页面顶端。
senses.why: The Latin noun numerus named a count, and English kept the idea of a unit you can point at, so the sign for a count and the count itself share one name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁名词 numerus 指「数目」，英语保留了「可以被指认的一个计数单位」这个想法，因此表示数目的符号与数目本身共用同一个词。

senses.title: A label that identifies a person or thing
senses.definition: a set of figures or a single figure printed on something so that it can be told apart from others
senses.definitionCN: 印在物品上的一组数字或一个数字，用来把它与别的同类区分开
senses.example: Her phone number changed after she moved.
senses.exampleCN: 搬家之后她的电话号码变了。
senses.why: Once a figure marks a position in a list, it can also mark identity, because a house, a phone or a ticket is known by the figure printed on it.
senses.whyCN: 数字一旦标出某物在名单中的位置，也就能标出身份，因为房子、电话或票据正是靠印在上面的数字被人认出的。

senses.title: The total amount of a group
senses.definition: the total count of people or things, especially when it is measured or compared with another total
senses.definitionCN: 人或物的总数，尤指被计量或与另一个总数作比较时
senses.example: The number of visitors doubled this summer.
senses.exampleCN: 今年夏天游客数量翻了一倍。
senses.why: Counting a whole group produces one total, so English let the word for a count stand for the size of the group itself.
senses.whyCN: 把一整群数完会得到一个总数，于是英语让表示计数的词直接指这一群的大小。

senses.title: One item in a numbered series
senses.definition: a single item in a numbered series, such as a song in a show or an issue of a magazine, named by its position
senses.definitionCN: 按编号排列的序列中的一项，如演出中的一首歌或杂志的一期，用它的位置来称呼
senses.example: She sang the closing number of the show.
senses.exampleCN: 她唱了演出的压轴曲目。
senses.why: A position in a list turns into a name for whatever sits in that position, so performers speak of the next number without naming the song.
senses.whyCN: 名单上的一个位置会变成占据那个位置的事物的名字，所以演员会说「下一号节目」，而不必点出歌名。

senses.title: To amount to a total
senses.definition: to add up to a particular total, or to count a group and find how many there are
senses.definitionCN: 加起来达到某个总数，或把一群数一遍以得出有多少
senses.example: The crowd numbered more than a thousand.
senses.exampleCN: 人群总数超过了一千人。
senses.why: When a count is applied to a whole group, the noun turns into a verb: you number the group and arrive at its total.
senses.whyCN: 当「数」这个动作落到一整群上，名词就转成动词：你把这群数一遍，就得到它的总数。

intro.en: Number comes from Latin numerus, a word for a count, which reached English through Old French and kept both the thing counted and the act of counting.
intro.cn: number 来自拉丁语 numerus，本义是「数目」，经古法语进入英语，同时保留了「被数的东西」和「数这个动作」两重意思。

items.en: Numerus meant a number, a count or a group counted together, and it was the everyday word for arithmetic quantities.
items.cn: numerus 指数目、计数或一起数出的一群，是表示算术数量的常用词。

items.en: The verb numerare meant to count or to enumerate, and it supplied the action behind the English noun.
items.cn: 动词 numerare 意为数、逐一清点，为英语名词提供了「数」这个动作。

items.en: Old French shortened the Latin word to nombre, which named both a figure and a total; English borrowed this form rather than the Latin one.
items.cn: 古法语把拉丁词缩短为 nombre，既指数字也指总数；英语借的是这个形式，而不是拉丁原形。

items.en: Middle English wrote the borrowed word as noumbre or nombre and used it for figures, totals and the numbering of things in order.
items.cn: 中古英语把借来的词写作 noumbre 或 nombre，用来指数目、总数以及按顺序编号。

items.en: Modern English fixed the spelling as number and extended it to phone numbers, house numbers, magazine issues and musical items.
items.cn: 现代英语把拼写固定为 number，并把词义扩展到电话号码、门牌号、杂志期号与演出曲目。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words built on the same Latin stem; the near-meaning group collects other words for figures, amounts and totals.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁词干上的词；近义组收其他表示数字、数量与总数的词。

entries.definition: A written sign or word that stands for a number.
entries.definitionCN: 代表一个数的书写符号或词。

entries.definition: Existing in large numbers; very many.
entries.definitionCN: 数量很多的；众多的。

entries.definition: To name things one by one, as if counting them.
entries.definitionCN: 逐一列举，如同清点。

entries.definition: Able to understand and work with numbers.
entries.definitionCN: 会读会算的；有计算能力的。

entries.definition: One of the written signs from zero to nine used to build numbers.
entries.definitionCN: 从零到九的书写符号之一，用来组成数字。

entries.definition: A written symbol for a number, or an amount expressed in numbers.
entries.definitionCN: 数字符号，或用数字表示的数额。

entries.definition: An amount or number of something, often measured.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的数量，常指可计量的量。

entries.definition: The whole amount reached when everything is added together.
entries.definitionCN: 把所有部分加在一起得到的全部数额。

normalIntro.en: The word rests on a Latin noun of counting, and its family keeps returning to signs, totals and the act of naming things in order.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词建立在表示计数的拉丁名词上，同族词反复回到符号、总数以及按顺序点名的动作。

normal.en: Numerus in Latin means a count, so number begins as something you can point at before it becomes an abstract idea.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 numerus 意为数目，所以 number 起初是能用手指数出来的东西，之后才变成抽象概念。

normal.en: Numeral and numerous share the same stem: one names the sign, the other says how many there are.
normal.cn: numeral 与 numerous 共用同一词干：一个指符号，另一个说数量有多少。

normal.en: Enumerate adds en- and -ate to the same stem, literally counting items out one at a time.
normal.cn: enumerate 在同一词干前加 en-、后加 -ate，字面就是一项一项数出来。

normal.en: A phone number or a house number is a count turned into an identity label.
normal.cn: 电话号码或门牌号，是被转成身份标签的计数。

normal.en: In the phrase a number of, the word stops naming a figure and starts meaning a group of things.
normal.cn: 在 a number of 这个词组里，它不再指一个数字，而开始表示一群事物。

abstract.en: A number is a promise that unlike things can still be compared, because it puts them on one scale.
abstract.cn: 数字是一种承诺：彼此不同的事物也能比较，因为它把它们放在同一把尺子上。

abstract.en: That one word covers symbol, total and label shows how counting turns the world into something English can manage.
abstract.cn: 一个词同时覆盖符号、总数与标签，说明计数把世界变成了英语可以打理的东西。

abstract.en: Every number is a position on an endless line, which is why a figure can also name a place in a queue.
abstract.cn: 每个数都是无尽直线上的一个位置，所以一个数字也能指队列中的某个位次。

examples.en: The number of rainy days fell sharply this year.
examples.cn: 今年雨天的数量大幅下降。

examples.en: Please write your membership number on the form.
examples.cn: 请在表格上写下你的会员编号。

examples.en: The volunteers numbered over forty at the end of the day.
examples.cn: 一天结束时，志愿者总数超过了四十人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「那么」——数一数有那么多个，记住 number 就是数目。

root: 拉丁语 numerus（数目、计数）经古法语 nombre 进入英语；同族词多与数、清点有关。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is a count you can point at; identity labels, group totals, positions in a series and the verb of counting a whole all grow from that unit.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是可以被指认的一个数目；身份标签、群体总数、序列中的位置，以及数整群的动词，都从这个单位长出来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of counting beads, each one sitting in a place that can be counted.
core.cn: 核心意象：一列整齐的算珠，每一颗都占着一个可以数出来的位置。

branches.en: a child pointing at a written figure and saying it aloud
branches.cn: 孩子指着写下的数字，把它念出声

branches.en: a phone ringing and a person found by the label on it
branches.cn: 电话响起，靠上面的标签找到一个人

branches.en: a crowd being counted one by one at the gate
branches.cn: 在门口把人群一个一个数过去

branches.en: a singer announced as the closing item of the show
branches.cn: 歌手被报幕为压轴曲目

branches.en: a total written at the bottom of a long list
branches.cn: 长名单末尾写下的总数

intro.en: The word is held up by a Latin noun of counting and its verb, passed on through an Old French shortening, then dressed in English suffixes for 'without', 'process' and 'full of'.
intro.cn: 这个词由表示计数的拉丁名词与动词支撑，经古法语的缩短形式传来，再穿上表示「没有」「过程」「充满」的英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin numerus and numerare are recorded directly and supply the stem behind numeral, numerous and enumerate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 numerus 与 numerare 有直接记录，为 numeral、numerous、enumerate 提供了词干。

definition_en: a game in which two or four players hit a ball over a net using rackets
core_image: 一张球网隔开两人：球被球拍来回击打过网
scene: 周末清晨，球拍击球的脆响在球场回荡，汗水洒在红色的地面上。 We played tennis on the clay court until noon.
sceneCN: 这里 tennis 是「网球运动」（第 1 个义项：一种隔网用球拍击球的球类运动）；句意是我们一直在红土网球场上打球打到中午。

derivatives.zh: table + tennis 复合词，义为「乒乓球」，缩小版网球运动
tennis + elbow 复合词，义为「网球肘」，一种常见于网球运动员的肘部劳损

senses.title: The sport of hitting a ball over a net
senses.definition: a game in which two or four players use rackets to hit a ball back and forth over a net
senses.definitionCN: 由两名或四名运动员用球拍隔着球网来回击球的球类运动
senses.example: She plays tennis every weekend with her sister.
senses.exampleCN: 她每个周末都和姐姐一起打网球。
senses.why: The core image is the net splitting two sides and the ball flying back and forth; the sport itself is named by this single image.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一张网隔开两方、球在空中来回飞：这项运动本身就用这一个画面命名，因此最基本义就是「网球运动」。

senses.title: The ball used in the game
senses.definition: the soft yellow-green ball used in the game of tennis
senses.definitionCN: 打网球所用的黄绿色软球
senses.example: A stray tennis rolled under the fence.
senses.exampleCN: 一个网球滚到了栅栏底下。
senses.why: The name of the game easily transfers to the object the game is played with; the sport lends its name to its ball.
senses.whyCN: 运动的名字很容易转指这项运动所用的器具：运动的名称借给了它使用的球，于是 tennis 也可指「网球（球本身）」。

senses.title: A tennis session or match occasion
senses.definition: an occasion or period of playing tennis
senses.definitionCN: 打网球的一次活动或时段
senses.example: Let's have a quick tennis before lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 午餐前我们快点打一场网球吧。
senses.why: Activities are often named without articles in English; the sport name becomes shorthand for one occasion of playing it.
senses.whyCN: 英语里活动名称常可省去冠词直接代指活动本身：运动名成为「打一次」的简称，义为一场网球活动。

senses.title: Tennis as a competitive professional world
senses.definition: the professional world or circuit of tennis competitions
senses.definitionCN: 职业网球赛事构成的世界或圈子
senses.example: She has spent a decade in professional tennis.
senses.exampleCN: 她在职业网坛已打拼了十年。
senses.why: A sport name can stand for the whole community and circuit built around it; playing becomes a career field.
senses.whyCN: 运动名称可代指围绕它建立的全部社群与赛事体系：打球变成一种职业领域，即「网坛」。

senses.title: Tennis as a school or club subject
senses.definition: tennis taught or organized as a course or club activity
senses.definitionCN: 作为课程或社团活动开设的网球项目
senses.example: Tennis is offered as an elective this term.
senses.exampleCN: 本学期开设网球选修课。
senses.why: Institutions name their offerings after the sport; the game becomes a labeled program within school or club life.
senses.whyCN: 学校与俱乐部用运动名来命名所开设的项目：网球运动成为课程表上的一个标签，即「网球课/项目」。

senses.title: Table tennis as a compound
senses.definition: used in compounds such as table tennis for similar net games
senses.definitionCN: 用于 table tennis 等复合词，指类似的隔网球类运动
senses.example: They watched table tennis on television.
senses.exampleCN: 他们看电视转播的乒乓球比赛。
senses.why: The image of hitting a ball over a net is copied at table size; the name travels into smaller versions of the game.
senses.whyCN: 隔网击球的画面被缩小到桌面上：这一运动名迁移到迷你版本，构成「乒乓球」等复合词。

senses.title: A tennis court or facility context
senses.definition: used to label courts, clubs, and equipment for the game
senses.definitionCN: 用于标注网球场、网球俱乐部及器材
senses.example: The tennis club opens at nine.
senses.exampleCN: 网球俱乐部九点开门。
senses.why: Facilities take the sport's name as a label; the game name marks the places where it is played.
senses.whyCN: 场地设施借运动名作标签：运动的名字标记了这项运动进行的场所。

senses.title: Historic real tennis as the original form
senses.titleCN: 历史用法：古式室内网球
senses.definition: real tennis, the older indoor form of the game played in royal courts
senses.definitionCN: real tennis，指起源于宫廷的旧式室内网球
senses.example: Real tennis survives in a few old courts in England.
senses.exampleCN: 古式网球仍在英国少数老球场存续。
senses.why: Before modern lawns, the game was played in walled courts; the historic form keeps the oldest sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 现代草地球场出现之前，这项运动在四壁围合的宫廷球场进行：历史形态保留了该词最古老的义项。

senses.title: Figurative back-and-forth exchange
senses.titleCN: 比喻用法：来回往复的交锋
senses.definition: a situation of actions or words going back and forth like a tennis rally
senses.definitionCN: 比喻言行像网球对打一样来回往复的局面
senses.example: The lawyers kept a tennis of objections and replies.
senses.exampleCN: 律师们你来我往， objections 与答辩不断交锋。
senses.why: The rally image of a ball flying back and forth maps onto any exchange of actions; the game becomes a metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 球来回对打的画面可以映射到任何往复的互动：运动名变成比喻，指你来我往的交锋。

intro.en: Tennis has an unusual etymology: it entered English from Old French as a shout used in the medieval ball game.
intro.cn: tennis 的词源颇为特别：它以中世纪球戏中的喊叫声身份从古法语进入英语。

items.en: The word is generally traced to Old French tenez, meaning hold, receive, the call made when serving the ball.
items.cn: 一般追溯至古法语 tenez（意为「接住、拿着」），是发球时的喊话。

items.en: The name appears in Middle English for the royal court game played indoors with the palm first, then rackets.
items.cn: 中古英语时期该词指宫廷室内球戏，最初徒手击球，后来改用球拍。

items.en: Rackets replaced the bare hand, and the game moved between indoor courts and open play.
items.cn: 球拍取代了徒手击球，游戏在室内球场与露天场地之间流转。

items.en: Modern lawn tennis was codified in the 1870s, giving the word its dominant present meaning.
items.cn: 现代草地网球于十九世纪七十年代定型，赋予了 tennis 如今的主导含义。

items.en: Today tennis means the global racket sport, its ball, and its professional world.
items.cn: 如今 tennis 指全球性的球拍运动、网球本身以及职业网坛。

note.en: Tennis is mostly a unique noun, but compounds and neighboring game words cause confusion.
note.cn: tennis 是较为独特的名词，但复合词与邻近的球类词汇容易造成混淆。

entries.definitionCN: 信条、原则。只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definitionCN: 不用球拍、团队隔网击球的排球运动

entries.definitionCN: 在封闭球场向墙壁击球的壁球运动

normalIntro.cn: 利用发球喊叫的来源和常见复合词来记忆 tennis。

normal.en: Tennis comes from Old French tenez, meaning take it: the server's shout before hitting the ball.
normal.cn: tennis 来自古法语 tenez（接住）：发球者击球前的喊话。

normal.en: Table tennis means table-size tennis: same net image, smaller court.
normal.cn: table tennis（乒乓球）：桌面版的 tennis，同样的隔网画面，更小的场地。

normal.en: A tennis court, a tennis racket, a tennis match: the word labels the whole gear set.
normal.cn: tennis court、tennis racket、tennis match：这个词为整套装备与场合打标签。

normal.en: Wimbledon is the most famous tennis tournament; champions become household names.
normal.cn: 温布尔登是最著名的网球赛事；冠军家喻户晓。

normal.en: Real tennis is the medieval indoor ancestor of modern tennis.
normal.cn: real tennis（古式网球）是现代网球的中世纪室内祖先。

abstract.en: Hear the old server shout tenez before each serve, and the name sticks to the game.
abstract.cn: 想象每次发球前老球员喊一声 tenez，名字便贴在了这项运动上。

abstract.en: Picture a yellow-green ball flying back and forth, drawing an arc over the net.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗黄绿色的球来回飞舞，在球网上空划出弧线。

abstract.en: Feel the rhythm of a rally: hit, reply, hit, like a conversation across the net.
abstract.cn: 感受对打的节奏：击球、回击、再击球，像隔着球网在对话。

examples.en: She won the tennis final in three straight sets.
examples.cn: 她直落三盘赢下网球决赛。

examples.en: The kids hit a tennis against the garage wall all afternoon.
examples.cn: 孩子们整个下午对着车库墙打网球。

examples.en: Their debate turned into a tennis of arguments and counterarguments.
examples.cn: 他们的辩论变成了你来我往的交锋。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 tennis 」谐音「忒耐死」——打网球忒累，耐力不足可不行。

root: tennis 一般认为源自古法语 tenez（tenir「拿、接」的命令式），是中世纪发球时的喊话「接住！」；词形先指宫廷室内球戏，十九世纪随草地网球定型为现代义。来源说法主流可靠，个别细节（何时由喊叫转成运动名）属一般推断。

sensesIntro.en: Tennis radiates from the sport itself to its ball, a playing occasion, the professional world, compounds, and metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: tennis 从运动本身辐射到网球用球、一次打球活动、职业网坛、复合词用法与比喻用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ball flying back and forth over a net between two sides
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗球隔着球网在两方之间来回飞舞

branches.en: The net game itself, from medieval courts to modern lawns
branches.cn: 隔网球戏本身，从中世纪宫廷到现代草地

branches.en: The name lends itself to the ball of the game
branches.cn: 运动名将自身借给它使用的球

branches.en: Play occasions, courses, and facilities take the sport's name

branches.en: The whole professional circuit is named by the sport
branches.cn: 整个职业赛事体系以运动名代指

branches.en: The net image copies into compounds and back-and-forth metaphors

intro.en: Tennis is a borrowed single word, but it forms many compounds and sport-family terms.
intro.cn: tennis 是借入的单词，但构成了大量复合词与球类运动家族词。

latinIntro.en: Tennis has no Latin relatives; it comes from Old French tenez, from Latin tenere at one further remove.
latinIntro.cn: tennis 没有直接的拉丁同源词；它来自古法语 tenez，间接可追至拉丁语 tenere。

definition_zh: 轮子；车轮；方向盘；推动；（鸟）盘旋
definition_en: a round object that turns on an axle, used under vehicles and machines, and by extension the act of turning or of pushing something along
core_image: 一只木轮压过土路，辐条在眼前飞快地转成一圈影子
scene: 牛车碾过土路，木轮转得辐条糊成一圈。 The back wheel of my bike came off on the hill.
sceneCN: 这里 wheel 是「轮子」（第 1 个义项：绕轴转动的圆形部件）；句意为我自行车的后轮在山坡上掉了。木轮压过土路、辐条糊成一圈影子，就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 轮子；车轮；方向盘；轮状物

derivatives.zh: 轮椅
独轮手推车
带轮的

senses.title: The turning ring under a vehicle
senses.definition: a circular object that turns about an axle and lets a vehicle or machine move
senses.definitionCN: 绕轴旋转的圆形物体，使车辆或机器得以移动
senses.example: The back wheel of my bike came off on the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 我自行车的后轮在山坡上掉了。
senses.why: This is the base sense of the word, and every other meaning either names a similar round thing or describes turning.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最基本的意思，其余含义若不是指类似的圆形物，就是描述转动。

senses.title: The thing you hold in a car
senses.definition: the circular handle in a vehicle by which the driver turns it
senses.definitionCN: 车辆中供驾驶员转向的圆形把手
senses.example: She never let anyone else take the wheel on long trips.
senses.exampleCN: 长途旅行时她从不让别人握方向盘。
senses.why: A steering wheel is just a wheel mounted on a column, and the part kept the name of the whole circle.
senses.whyCN: 方向盘不过是一枚装在转向柱上的轮，这个部件就沿用了整个圆的名称。

senses.title: A round flat object
senses.definition: something shaped like a wheel, especially a round food such as a cheese
senses.definitionCN: 形状像轮子的东西，尤指一轮圆形的食物如干酪
senses.example: They cut a whole wheel of cheese into thin slices.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把一整轮干酪切成薄片。
senses.why: The shape is the whole point, so the word simply moves onto anything round and flat with a rim.
senses.whyCN: 形状就是全部要点，于是这个词直接移用到任何圆而平、带边的东西上。

senses.title: To push something on wheels
senses.definition: to move something along on wheels, or to push a cart or trolley
senses.definitionCN: 用轮子把某物移走，或推手推车
senses.example: They wheeled the bed into the next room.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把床推进了隔壁的房间。
senses.why: Once the object is named, the same sound becomes the action of moving on it, as with any tool in English.
senses.whyCN: 物件被命名之后，同一个声音又成了靠它移动的动作，英语中任何工具词都可如此。

senses.title: To circle in the air
senses.definition: used of birds or aircraft turning in wide circles without moving away
senses.definitionCN: 用于鸟或飞机在空中绕大圈而不离开
senses.example: Gulls wheeled above the fishing boats all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 海鸥整下午都在渔船上方盘旋。
senses.why: A circle in the sky copies the motion of a wheel, so the verb turns the wheel picture ninety degrees up.
senses.whyCN: 天空中的圆圈拷贝了轮子的运动，于是这个动词把轮子的画面竖了起来。

intro.en: Wheel comes from Old English hwēol, from a Germanic root meaning to turn, and the same turning root lies behind the Latin words for circle and column.
intro.cn: wheel 源自古英语 hwēol，其日耳曼语词根意为「转动」，同一个转动的词根也藏在拉丁语的圆与轮子诸词中。

items.en: The root meant to turn or to roll, so the object was named for what it does rather than what it looks like.
items.cn: 这个词根意为转动或滚动，所以物件是按它做的事、而不是按样子命名的。

items.en: Hwēol appears in early riddles and poems about wagons and the sun moving across the sky.
items.cn: hwēol 出现在早期关于货车与日轮横空的谜语和诗歌中。

items.en: The spelling moved from hwēol to wheel, and the word was applied to the wheel of a ship and later of a cart.
items.cn: 拼写从 hwēol 变为 wheel，此词先用于船的舵轮，后用于马车的轮。

items.en: Roads and engines turned wheel into a verb for pushing carts and for birds circling in the air.
items.cn: 道路与引擎让 wheel 成为动词，表示推车以及鸟在空中盘旋。

items.en: The phrase behind the wheel marks the steering wheel, and wheels of industry carries the turning picture into economics.
items.cn: behind the wheel 标记着方向盘，wheels of industry 则把转动的画面带入经济。

note.en: The first group gathers round things or words spelled like wheel, the second the words for turning and for a driving position.
note.cn: 第一组收圆的东西或与 wheel 拼写相近的词，第二组收表示转动与驾驶位置的说法。

normalIntro.en: The word looks like a wheel on the page: a round o held between two uprights, and the doubled e is the two hubs.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词在纸面上就像一个轮子：两个竖笔夹住一个圆 o，双写 e 像两个轮毂。

normal.en: Wheel and wh-eel: an eel bent into a circle is a wheel.
normal.cn: wheel 里有 eel（鳗鱼）：一条鳗鱼弯成圈，就成了轮子。

normal.en: Behind the wheel is a place, not a thing: the driver's seat.
normal.cn: behind the wheel 是位置而不是物件：驾驶者的座位。

normal.en: A wheel of cheese borrows the shape and leaves the road behind.
normal.cn: a wheel of cheese 借走了形状，把马路留在了后面。

normal.en: Wheeling a bed is the same action as turning a wheel, without the round object.
normal.cn: 把床推走与转轮是同一个动作，只是没有那个圆东西。

normal.en: Gulls wheel because a circle in the air is a wheel seen from below.
normal.cn: 海鸥盘旋，因为空中的圆圈是从下方看到的轮子。

abstract.en: Feel the road under a wooden rim.
abstract.cn: 感觉木轮边下的路面。

abstract.en: See spokes blur into one grey disc.
abstract.cn: 看辐条糊成一张灰色圆盘。

abstract.en: Hear a cart stop with a single knock.
abstract.cn: 听马车咯噔一声停住。

examples.en: One wheel of the cart was stuck in the mud.
examples.cn: 马车的一只轮子陷进了泥里。

examples.en: He fell asleep at the wheel and woke up at the lights.
examples.cn: 他开车时睡着了，到红绿灯才醒来。

examples.en: Nurses wheeled the patient down the corridor.
examples.cn: 护士把病人推过走廊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威尔」——威尔推着车走，轮子吱吱响，一路滚到村口。

root: 日耳曼语词根（转动、滚动）→ 古英语 hwēol → 中古英语 wheel；同族有 whirl、wheelchair、wheelbarrow。

sensesIntro.en: The word names the turning ring first, then the steering ring, then any round slab, then the act of pushing on wheels, and finally the circling of a bird.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词先指会转的圈，再指方向盘那个圈，然后指任何圆块，接着指用车推的动作，最后指鸟的盘旋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wooden rim turning with its spokes blurred.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只木轮转得辐条发糊。

branches.en: The vehicle branch: a bike wheel coming off on the hill.
branches.cn: 车辆分支：山坡上掉落的自行车轮。

branches.en: The driving branch: never letting anyone take the wheel.
branches.cn: 驾驶分支：从不让别人握方向盘。

branches.en: The shape branch: a wheel of cheese cut into slices.
branches.cn: 形状分支：切成片的一轮干酪。

branches.en: The action branch: wheeling a bed into the next room.
branches.cn: 动作分支：把床推进隔壁房间。

branches.en: The sky branch: gulls wheeling above the boats.
branches.cn: 天空分支：渔船上方盘旋的海鸥。

intro.en: Wheel is a whole Old English noun that also serves as a verb, and the family grows through -ing, -ed and compounds such as -chair and -barrow.
intro.cn: wheel 是完整的古英语名词，也能作动词，词族通过 -ing、-ed 及 -chair、-barrow 等复合成分扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin word for wheel, rota, also gave rotate and rotor, so the entries below are the borrowed cousins of the same object.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表轮的 rota 也产生了 rotate 与 rotor，所以下面的条目是同一物件的借入近亲。

items.example: It is both a noun and a verb.
items.exampleCN: 它既可作名词也可作动词。

items.example: It is the earliest recorded shape.
items.exampleCN: 它是最早有记录的词形。

items.example: The wheel keeps only half the name here.
items.exampleCN: 这里轮只保留了一半的名字。

items.example: It names a position rather than an object.
